description: Reads the Live app's Errors, the Logs page's own section: each refusal code with its count, first and last seen, the newest refusal's own sentence, an example Logs row id, and the page that explains the code (https://docs.gemmein.com/errors/<code>; null while a code has no page yet). The last 7 days, or the last `hours` (1–168); up to 50 codes. live:read; audited; changes nothing. This is what a founder may call something being wrong or broken.
